text: Ordered a set of saucepans on Friday and they were here on Saturday morning. Heavy bases, they heat evenly, and a fair price for the quality.
The chair wobbled from day one and one armrest came loose. Customer service told me to 'tighten the screws' and then stopped replying.
Lovely scented soaps, but they came wrapped in so much plastic that I felt guilty opening the parcel. And shipping took nine days.
The support team helped me pick the right charger for my camera, and it came in a neat recycled box.
Way too expensive for a plastic toy, and it arrived a week late.
The hiking backpack is comfortable and well made. The courier left it out in the rain, but the waterproof bag it was packed in kept it dry. Price was steep though.
Not a single complaint: cheap, cheerful, and my kids adore the puzzle.
Your box was so flimsy that the lamp shade arrived dented. Nobody answered my email about it either.
The hair dryer is powerful and light, and it came in a sturdy box with no plastic at all.
Paid 30 for express shipping, a total rip-off, because the parcel still took a whole week. Never again.
The agent on the phone was patient and sorted my exchange quickly, but the replacement trousers have the same loose stitching as the first pair.
Cheapest place for printer ink by far, and it always arrives the next day.
The garden gnome arrived with its head snapped off. It had been rolling around in a huge box with no padding at all.
Delivered ahead of schedule, great. The support email address bounced when I tried to ask about assembly, though.
Lovely customer service: they answered my question about the ingredients within an hour and really knew their stuff.
The yoga leggings went see-through after two washes. For 70 euros that's shameful.
Beautiful leather wallet, feels like it will last for years. It sat in a warehouse for twelve days before shipping, though.
The courier called ahead and was right on time, and the vase was bubble-wrapped so well I needed scissors for five minutes.
I asked three times for an invoice and nobody from the shop ever replied. Poor service.
Great price for a really solid set of dumbbells. Very happy.
Half the price of the brand-name vacuum and it does the same job. The packaging was excessive though, a huge box of foam peanuts for a small item.
The toaster burns one side and leaves the other pale. Support said that's normal.
The support lady was so kind when I called about sizing. Sadly the jumper is itchy and already pilling.
The delivery fee was higher than the product itself, and the parcel still turned up late.
